prompt:
You are shown face-up playing cards arranged as a hand, labeled hands, or labeled candidate cards. Use standard five-card poker ranking. Compare categories first; if categories match, use the usual rank tie-breakers with Ace high. Identify the option letter for the winning poker hand.
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every card in the winning poker hand.
Required answer format: set "answer" to only the winning poker hand option letter.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[120,80,200,190],[220,80,300,190],[320,80,400,190],[420,80,500,190],[520,80,600,190]],"answer":"B"}
